command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== verify the staged genome set against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 6fa8884c45af0178a24c28413ccfdf7018915e843f106667787f749b4a7aaadc genomes20.tar > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256
# A directory of inputs travels as one flat tar on this path. Untarring creates files the
# container owns, so these -- unlike the staged tar itself -- are safe to remove later.
tar -xf genomes20.tar
N=$(ls GCF_*.fna.gz | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SPP=$(awk -F'\t' '{print $2}' labels.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo "genomes $N  species $SPP"

echo "== mash sketch + all-pairs dist: 20 genomes, k=21, s=10000 =="
T0=$(date +%s)
mash sketch -p 8 -k 21 -s 10000 -o all GCF_*.fna.gz 2> sketch.log
mash dist -p 8 all.msh all.msh > dist.tsv
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))

# mash dist writes: <ref> <query> <distance> <p-value> <shared/total hashes>, one line per
# ordered pair, so 20x20 = 400 rows of which 20 are self-comparisons.
ROWS=$(awk 'END{print NR}' dist.tsv)
# A genome's distance to itself is 0 by construction -- an exact identity, not a band.
SELFMAX=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2{if($3>m)m=$3} END{printf "%.10f", m+0}' dist.tsv)

# The truth is NCBI's: labels.tsv came from each genome's own defline. For each genome the
# nearest of the other 19 must be its own species' second strain -- 20 independent tests.
NN=$(awk -F'\t' '
  NR==FNR { sp[$1".fna.gz"]=$2; next }
  $1!=$2 { if (!($1 in best) || $3 < bestd[$1]) { best[$1]=$2; bestd[$1]=$3 } }
  END { ok=0; for (g in best) if (sp[g]==sp[best[g]]) ok++; print ok }
' labels.tsv dist.tsv)

# Stronger than nearest-neighbour: every within-species distance below every between-species
# one means the 10 clusters are cleanly separated, not merely locally correct.
read -r WMAX BMIN <<<"$(awk -F'\t' '
  NR==FNR { sp[$1".fna.gz"]=$2; next }
  $1==$2 { next }
  { if (sp[$1]==sp[$2]) { if ($3>w) w=$3 } else { if (b=="" || $3<b) b=$3 } }
  END { printf "%.6f %.6f", w, b }
' labels.tsv dist.tsv)"

{
  echo "genomes            $N   want exactly 20"
  echo "species            $SPP   want exactly 10 (2 strains each)"
  echo "dist_rows          $ROWS   want exactly 400 (20x20 ordered pairs)"
  echo "max_self_distance  $SELFMAX   want exactly 0 (a genome equals itself)"
  echo "nearest_same_sp    $NN   want exactly 20 of 20"
  echo "max_within_species $WMAX"
  echo "min_between_species $BMIN   want > max_within_species   [clean separation]"
  echo "wall_s             $WALL"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$N"       -eq 20
test "$SPP"     -eq 10
test "$ROWS"    -eq 400
test "$NN"      -eq 20
awk -v m="$SELFMAX" 'BEGIN{exit !(m==0)}'
awk -v w="$WMAX" -v b="$BMIN" 'BEGIN{exit !(b>w)}'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
